text:
ellie_csm: Quick planning thread Orion Labs pilot onboarding. They asked for a 60m kickoff + two 30m follow-up office hours. Prework incomplete (sample prompts + firewall rules). Renewal check in ~5w. Need hosts and deliverables.

dev_kate: I can host kickoff (60m) Tue 2026-07-14 09:00 PT / 18:00 BST. Will demo deployment flow + routing. Need someone for hands-on exercises.

frank_pm: We should offer office hours at two different windows: one EMEA-friendly evening and one APAC-morning. Also add a 10m internal sync before the session.

lee_solutions: I9ll run both office hours and build two short labs (15m each). Please share sample prompts, a sample config.yaml, and CIDR whitelist by EOD Monday.

ellie_csm: Proposed calendar blocks: 
- Kickoff 60m: Tue 2026-07-14 09:00 PT / 18:00 BST
- Office hour 1 (30m): Fri 2026-07-17 17:30 BST
- Office hour 2 (30m): Mon 2026-07-20 09:00 SGT
Internal host rehearsal: 15m immediately before kickoff.

dev_kate: Agenda sketch: intros (5m), preflight checklist & networking (10m), live deploy demo (20m), short lab walkthrough (15m), Q&A & next steps (10m). Add a short ROI/cost slide.

frank_pm: I'll create the ROI slide and a 3-question poll for post-session capture: usefulness, blockers remaining, renewal signal. Can we automate survey send 24h after via our CRM?

ellie_csm: Yes CS automation can. @notify-bot please enqueue survey for thread 1799991111 after kickoff.

notify-bot: Survey scheduled: Orion Kickoff followup (NPS+blockers) in 24h. :white_check_mark:

lee_solutions: I'll make the invites with Zoom and record on by default. Will attach a short Loom covering prework steps. Also will upload clipped demo snippets after session.

dev_kate: Small ask: include account metadata in the invite (account_tier:pilot, renewal_window:5w, prework:pending). Helps on-call and CS during session.

ellie_csm: Will add metadata tags. Action items: ellie - ask customer for prompts + CIDR (today); lee - create invites + lab materials (Mon); dev_kate - ROI one-pager + rehearsal (Mon); frank - survey + slides (Mon). If they can't do these windows, fallback to same weekdays the following week.

ellie_csm: I'll confirm with the customer and update here. Quick win: mention recommended network ports and a 2-min checklist in the invite to reduce friction. :thumbsup:

frank_pm: Also capture a quick poll live at the end of the kickoff to surface blockers in real-time. Good to catch migration risks early.

lee_solutions: Agreed. I'll add the poll in the Zoom Q&A flow.
